name: mandoc
description: ManDoc: secure document library and tracked share links for Mantu staff.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p e2e && tsc --noEmit -p scripts
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-dev-vars.mjs && npm run build -w @mandoc/web && npm exec -w @mandoc/api -- wrangler d1 migrations apply mandoc-dev --local --env dev && npm run dev -w @mandoc/api
